identity: Wins: early lead into objective conversion. In LEC playoffs G2 averaged GD@15 +1490, 70% first tower, 81% baron and 62% dragon control, with Caps (GD@15 +501, 15 solo kills) and the bot lane (Hans Sama +348) driving leads. Summer playoffs: 9-1, GD@15 +856, first tower 90%, baron 87%. Loses: when behind early against top international teams. Internationally G2 averaged GD@15 -615, first tower 37%, herald 42%, baron 48%; WR when ahead @15 is still ~78% so deficits are the problem. Red side is a stark weakness internationally (4-14, 22%) vs blue 13-4 (76%); in LEC playoffs the gap is small (blue 22-6, red 6-2). Top, bot and support all had negative GD@15 and XPD@15 internationally (BrokenBlade -285, Hans Sama -180, Labrov -75).
draft: Picks and bans from gol.gg 2026 samples. Comfort picks (domestic playoffs): Orianna (Caps 5-0), Yunara and Ashe (Hans Sama 6-2, 5-0), Lulu and Bard (Labrov 5-1, 4-1), Xin Zhao/Skarner/Jarvan IV (SkewMond 4-2, 4-1, 3-1), Rumble/Kled/K'Sante (BrokenBlade 4-0, 4-0, 3-1). Internationally pool gets thinner in results: Aurora/Syndra/Ahri (Caps 2-2, 2-2, 1-3), Yunara 2-3, Nautilus 1-4, Lulu 2-3, K'Sante 2-3. Opponents ban Orianna (20% intl, 14% dom), Varus, Pantheon, Poppy, Bard (32% intl) against G2. G2's own bans lean to Orianna (58% intl), Jayce, Ryze, Akali, Varus. Flex: Caps plays Orianna/Taliyah/Ryze/Aurora/Syndra/Ahri/LeBlanc/Akali (pool 16-17), SkewMond pool 15-17. Explicit first-pick priority UNKNOWN (gol.gg draft order not scraped).

identity: Wins: draws on late-game and objective control rather than early leads. In 2026 playoffs (38 games) MKOI averaged GD@15 -250, first blood 39%, but baron 53% (70% in Summer playoffs) and first tower 58%; avg game 33.3 min. Elyoya (KP 75%) and Alvaro (KP 78%) are the shot-callers; Supa carries 29% of damage with 26% gold share. Loses: red side (3-12, 20% in LEC playoffs vs blue 17-6, 74%), early top-lane deficits (Myrwn GD@15 -336, CSD@15 -3.5) and slow herald/dragon starts (herald 40%, dragon 49%). Against G2 in the final the team was swept; only 4 international games in 2026 so international sample is tiny.
draft: Sample: 38 LEC playoff games. Comfort picks: Caitlyn (Supa 5-2) and Ezreal (3-2), Lee Sin/Pantheon (Elyoya 3-2, 3-1), Anivia (Jojopyun 3-1), Neeko/Rakan (Alvaro 3-3, 3-2), Renekton (Myrwn 3-1); Ornn and K'Sante 2-2 each. Broad pools (Myrwn 18, Elyoya 18 champions). Opponents ban Nocturne (39%), Vi (32%), Cassiopeia and Rumble (26% each) against MKOI. MKOI's own bans: Olaf, Dr. Mundo, Jarvan IV, Nocturne. Flex: Jojopyun Ahri/Ryze/Anivia mid. First-pick priority UNKNOWN. Tiny EWC sample (4 games): Vayne (75% ban rate by MKOI).

identity: Wins: by getting early advantages and converting through the side lanes: domestic playoffs first blood 64%, GD@15 +238, WR when ahead @15 ~77%; Canna (Rumble 8-2) and Yike (Vi 8-3) are the engines; Busio/Seraphine-Rakan 12-3 combined. Loses: neutral objectives and mid/late game: baron 53% domestic and just 26% internationally (25% at EWC, 28% at MSI), 4-7 in the latest playoffs; red side internationally 3-7 (30%). Caliste's Ezreal is 4-9 over 2026 playoff and international games (Ezreal 2-5 dom, 2-4 intl). Internationally GD@15 only +80 and bot lane negative (Caliste -239).
draft: Sample: 50 LEC playoff games, 23 international games. Comfort: Rumble (Canna 8-2 dom, 4-2 intl), Gnar (3-2/3-2), Vi (Yike 8-3 dom), Ryze/Ahri (Kyeahoo 5-2, 4-1 dom), Ashe (Caliste 5-2), Seraphine/Rakan (Busio 6-2, 6-1). Internationally pool shifts: Yike Naafiri/Wukong/Qiyana, Kyeahoo Orianna/Cassiopeia/Anivia (2-2 each), Busio Camille 0-4. Opponents ban Varus (30%), Rumble (22%), Yunara, Nocturne against KC domestically and Poppy 52%, Vi 48%, Jayce 48% internationally. KC bans Pantheon, Nautilus (28% each), Nocturne, Vi domestically; Nocturne 43% internationally. First-pick priorities UNKNOWN.
